title: extract survey run 결과 (v0)
description: 요구사항 추출 extract의 survey run이 내는 결과 제안(requirements-extraction-flow.md 16.4, 17.3, 결정 35~37). 빌드 진입점에서 구성 후보, 진입점·인터페이스 인벤토리, 벤더 경계, 분석 단위 제안을 낸다. survey에는 렌즈 점검표가 없다. 공통 $defs는 trace와 같아야 한다(skills/check.mjs가 본다). 필드 설명은 지시의 필드 안내(L3)로 렌더링하므로 영어로 쓴다(16.2, D98).

outcome.description: done: covered the assigned scope. incomplete: deadline, limit or context ran out (checkpoint required).

outcome_reason.description: One or two sentences on why this outcome.

inventory.description: Entry points (reset, vectors, ISRs, tasks, command tables and commands, DMA channels) and interfaces.

boundaries.description: Vendor HAL, RTOS kernel, third-party or generated code whose internals are not traced (kept as a boundary).

units.description: Proposed analysis units, each with a lens.

not_found.description: What you looked for and did not find, with the searches.

unknowns.description: What code cannot settle and needs outside material, measurement or a person. Things you could still trace in code go to followups (trace) or units (survey).

human_decisions.description: Only for the closed triggers. Plain lack of material is an unknown, not a decision.

checkpoint.description: Required when outcome is incomplete: where to resume. Otherwise null.

key.description: Local key, unique within this result (e.g. o1, q2). Other items point to it from refs.

refs.description: Keys of other items in this result.

configs.description: Configuration names this applies to, as named in the packet. Use the single name "all" only when a tool showed it is active in every confirmed configuration. Never merge behavior of different configurations into one item.

anchor.description: Where the evidence is. quote is a short verbatim copy of lines you opened in this run.

kind.description: code: source at the base commit. tool_output: output file of a tool you ran in scratch. doc_claim: a claim in a document or comment inside the repo. external_spec: material outside the repo (datasheet, standard).

path.description: Repo-relative path. For tool_output the output file in scratch; for external_spec the document id.

command.description: For tool_output the command you ran, otherwise null.

search.description: One search that supports an absence or a not_applicable.

tool.description: Tool used (Grep, Glob, a Bash command).

needs.description: What would settle it: external_doc (datasheet, spec), measurement (on real hardware), toolchain (a build or tool you could not run), other.

unit.description: A proposed analysis unit. Give priority, dependencies and the reason as data; the app picks the order.

trigger.description: Closed triggers only: scope_budget (widen scope or budget), shipping_config (which configuration ships cannot be told from code), product_intent (interpreting product intent), toolchain_material (a toolchain or material the intent did not provide).

name.description: Configuration name (build target or board). Later runs refer to the configuration by this name.

status.description: confirmed: build files or a tool show this configuration is built. candidate: not confirmed (shipping or buildability unknown).

select.description: How it is selected (make target, defining macro, ...).

build_command.description: A command to reproduce the build, or null if unknown.

kind.description: Kind of entry point or interface.

notes.description: Short note; empty string if none.

path.description: Repo-relative path kept as a boundary.

reason.description: Why it is vendor or third-party code (path, license header, submodule, ...).

what.description: What you looked for and did not find.
